notablePrerequisites: All modes but "Abandon Ship" have been chosen for Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Blim.
When Blim deals combat damage, Blim triggers, causing (among other effects) target opponent to gain control of Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
At the beginning of that opponent's upkeep, they are forced to choose the "Abandon Ship" mode and lose the game.
